name: a Sent list seen before an email claim's grace sync never makes it NOT_FOUND; a later one can
notes: §6.1 v1.14: a gmail.sent entry counts towards full coverage only if its lastSyncAt ≥ the claim's grace sync, max(end(p,t) + graceMin, end(p,t) + afterClaimMin); any other overlapping entry is capped with coverage.list_unsettled. A Sent list read before it shows a reply sent elsewhere (an agent replying through the API: Gmail lists the reply under its conversation's newest minute once the list refreshes, and a conversation row is never a row, contract v1.13) vouches for a span it has not settled (tech re-review TECH-R2). A capped entry still counts for grace, and a row it saw still verifies.

Coverage (acct-a, bound by the grant): E1, a pass at 14:06 that read a list not yet refreshed: [09:01, 14:06], synced 14:06. E2, a pass at 15:00 after the refresh: the reply's conversation is now listed at 14:05, so the window starts a minute after it: [14:06, 15:00], synced 15:00. evaluatedAt 15:00.

c1: muse says at 14:05 (minute) it replied to bob@northwind.example 'Re: plan'. Window [14:03, 14:51] (start 14:05 − 2, end 14:06 + 45); grace sync = 14:06 + max(30, 45) = 14:51. E1 synced 14:06 < 14:51 → capped; E2 is uncapped but starts 14:06, so [14:03, 14:06) is seen by no uncapped entry → coverage partial. No candidate (o1 is to another domain, no shared subject word: no content feature, the content gate). Rules: verified, partial no; pending no (E2 synced 15:00 ≥ 14:51); partial_coverage → UNVERIFIABLE, PENDING until end + finalizeUnverifiableHours. Reasons coverage.partial, coverage.list_unsettled (both {source: gmail.sent}), match.none.
Under v1.13 the union of E1 and E2 contained c1's window and c1 was NOT_FOUND, FINAL: a false NOT_FOUND for a reply the list had not shown yet (Hard Rule 5).

c2: muse says at 13:00 it emailed dana@fabrikam.example 'Invoice'. Window [12:58, 13:46]; grace sync 13:01 + 45 = 13:46. E1 synced 14:06 ≥ 13:46 → not capped, and [09:01, 14:06] contains the window → full. graceElapsed (E1 14:06 ≥ 13:46). No candidate → not_found → NOT_FOUND, FINAL at evaluatedAt 15:00. The grant binds acct-a, so no coverage.account_unbound; reasons match.none.

c3: muse says at 14:04 it emailed carol@company.com 'Agenda'. o1 (seen by E1's pass, observedAt 14:06): identical address and subject, inside [14:04, 14:05] → timeProximity 1, counterpartyExact 1, counterpartyDomain 1, subjectOverlap 1: S = 9000/9000 = 1/1 → verified (it precedes every coverage rule). FINAL (§8 VERIFIED): E2 synced 15:00 ≥ end + graceMin = 14:05 + 30 = 14:35. Reasons match.best {observationId: o1}.
